# Page

The roaster controls heat, airflow and time for every batch of green coffee.

Espresso is brewed with nine bars of pressure for about twenty eight seconds, using eighteen grams of finely ground coffee and yielding thirty six grams of liquid in the cup, which the shop treats as its house standard for every blend it serves to customers during the day and the evening.

Keep the portafilter dry and the basket clean.

Cupping is the standard tasting protocol that we use to evaluate each lot.
